_about: How the mouse turns into aim and power, and where the cameras sit. Metres, seconds, radians.

aim._about: radPerPixel: how far the aim turns per pixel of mouse movement. fineFactor: the share of that while fine aim (Shift) is held. keyRadPerSec: turning speed with the arrow keys.
aim._aboutCenter: Only when the browser will not capture the mouse: the cursor works like a stick. Within centerDeadShare of the middle (a share of half the screen width) the aim stands still. Beyond it the aim turns, up to centerRadPerSec at the screen edge. centerCurve above 1 makes it gentle near the middle.

power._about: pullPixels: mouse travel for a full pull. curve: above 1 gives more room for soft shots. minShare: the softest shot as a share of the hardest. minPullToShoot: a smaller pull than this cancels the shot.
power._aboutCenter: Power is the cursor's distance from the cue ball on the screen. deadPixels: within this distance of the ball the power is nothing. Full power is at pullPixels beyond that, or at screenShare of the window's shorter side if that is less (so a small window still reaches full power).

camera._about: The aiming camera sits aimBack behind the cue ball and aimHeight above the felt, and looks at a point aimLookAhead in front of the ball. follow: how quickly it glides to a new place (higher is quicker).

cue._about: restGap: tip to ball while aiming. pullDistance: how far the cue draws back at full power.
cue._aboutAngle: How far the butt of the cue can be raised, in degrees above the lowest (the lowest is the default in physics.json, about 4). wheelStepDeg: degrees per notch of the mouse wheel. resetAfterShot: the cue goes back down after every shot.
cue._aboutRaisedPower: The share of full power left when the cue is raised all the way; in between it falls evenly. A steep cue cannot be swung as hard.

spin._about: Where the tip hits the cue ball. sideSpin: false locks the hit point to the up-down line (top and back spin only). dragPixels: mouse travel, with the right button held, from the middle of the ball to its edge. keyPerSec: how fast W and S (and A and D) move the hit point, in ball radii per second. resetAfterShot: the hit point goes back to the middle after every shot.

place._about: How far the cue ball in hand moves per pixel of mouse movement.
